definitions.short: properly, something very smooth ; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment
definitions.full: H2519. chalaqlaqqoth חֲלַקְלַקּוֺת noun plural feminine abstract smoothness, slipperiness, flattery, fine promises ; 1 slipperiness וַחֲלַקְלַקֹּת חשׁך יהידֿרכם Psa 35:6 ; כַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֺת להם דרכם יהיה Jer 23:12 . 2 fine promises בַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֺה מלכוּת והחזיק Dan 11:21 ; compare 11:34 .

occurrences.englishText: Let their way be dark and slippery,
Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness.
“In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.
